# simplemdm_logs (Data Source)

Fetches audit logs from your SimpleMDM account. Note: this data source fetches all logs and may be slow for accounts with large log volumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_logs" "recent" {}

output "log_count" {
  value = length(data.simplemdm_logs.recent.logs)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `logs` (Block List) Collection of log entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--logs))

<a id="nestedblock--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `at` (String) The timestamp when the log entry was created.
- `event_type` (String) The event type of the log entry (e.g. 'user.signed_in', 'script.ran').
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the log entry.
- `level` (String) The severity level of the log entry.
- `message` (String) The log message.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the log entry (e.g., 'mdm', 'user').
- `source` (String) The source of the log entry.
